azahar-state-confirm: Loading this state replaces the current gameplay progress. Continue?
azahar-state-error-load: Could not load the state. Check the core and system files. Restart the game if it behaves unexpectedly.
azahar-state-error-save: Could not save the state. No existing state was overwritten.
azahar-state-notice: Experimental manual save states. Restore with the same Azahar core and system data. GPU restoration may pause while shaders rebuild or fail; keep in-game saves.
azahar-state-unavailable: Azahar save states are not ready in this session.
azahar-system-missing: No system-data firmware selected. Add azahar-mii-system-data.zip to the folder and scan the 3DS platform.
azahar-system-notice: Place your own decrypted Mii system-data ZIP in the server's 3DS firmware folder once, then scan that platform. Azahar loads it automatically on every device.
azahar-system-path: Library path examples (use the firmware folder and layout configured on your server):
azahar-system-registered: Selected server firmware: {file}. It will be imported before the game starts.
azahar-system-step-dump: In GodMode9 on your own 3DS, decrypt the Mii .app to the SD card and copy its matching .tmd. Do not modify NAND.
azahar-system-step-play: Name the ZIP azahar-mii-system-data.zip and place it in the server's 3DS firmware folder. Scan the platform once; future launches select it automatically unless you chose another firmware.
azahar-system-step-zip: ZIP the decrypted .app and matching .tmd using the nand/... directory layout shown below.
azahar-system-warning: This does not generate Mii faces. CIA files, keys, full NAND dumps and CFL_DB.dat are unsupported. The server keeps the ZIP; browser data is restored from it at launch. Game-save bundles do not include these system files.
clear-cache-description: Any saves or states stored on the server will not be affected.
clear-cache-title: Are you sure you want to clear the EmulatorJS cache?
clear-cache-warning: This will remove all saves and states stored in the browser.
start-fresh-hint: Pick one below to resume, or hit Play to start fresh.
stream-error-not-configured: No streaming container is configured for {platform}.
stream-error-rom-not-found: This ROM could not be found. It may have been removed.
stream-occupied-fallback: Someone else is currently playing. Try again later.
stream-save-unconfirmed: The emulator did not confirm the save. Recent progress may be lost.
